_note: The monitoring channels. Anything a device posts to /api/sensors/ingest with a matching 'metric' appears here with these labels and thresholds. A device may also post a metric that is not listed — it will register itself and show up unconfigured, and you can add it here afterwards to give it a name and limits.
_thresholds: warnMin/warnMax is the expected band — outside it reads CAUTION. okMin/okMax are the hard limits — outside them reads OUT OF RANGE. A channel silent for longer than SENSOR_STALE_SECONDS reads SIGNAL LOST rather than showing a stale number.

channels.label: Air quality index
channels._note: Composite index from the VOC and particulate sensor. 0-50 good, 51-100 moderate, above 150 the habitat should ventilate.

channels.label: Particulates PM2.5
channels._note: Dust carried in on suits shows up here first.

channels.label: Radiation dose rate
channels._note: Background at sea level on Earth is roughly 0.1-0.3 µSv/h. The warning band is set just above ordinary background so any real change is visible.

channels.label: Cumulative dose
channels._note: Running total across the mission. Rises steadily; the shape matters more than the value.
